recommendation.reason: Agentic robot benchmark with expert-written real-world tasks, executable simulator verifier, scripted-controller solvability, low scores, and strong attention; no blocking rule fires.
risks: Evaluation layouts are held out, so test instances are not fully public.
Diagnosis LLM judge prompts and validation are not yet released.
Requires Isaac Sim and an NVIDIA GPU for container hosting.

tasks.quote: Its 30 tasks come from five real-world application domains and run at three difficulty levels in Clean and Random scenes, and agents and end-to-end policies are ranked on separate leaderboards.

verifier.quote: Physics-verified, task-specific scoring — scorers read physical measurements from the simulation, such as the final resistance.

runtime.quote: Use Linux, an NVIDIA GPU, and the Python 3.11 launcher supplied with Isaac Sim 5.1.
